reason_text.not_confirmed: The two readers did not both agree with the extracted value.
reason_text.analyte_not_parent: The value is not for the parent drug.
reason_text.coadministered: The arm gave another active drug with it.
reason_text.fixed_dose_combination: The product is a fixed-dose combination.
reason_text.formulation_not_immediate_release: The formulation is not immediate-release or a solution.
reason_text.bound_not_a_value: The source gives only a bound (for example 'more than'), not a value.
reason_text.per_kg_not_converted: The value is per kilogram; there is no body weight, so it is not converted.
reason_text.special_population: The value is for a special population (children, older adults, renal or hepatic impairment); special populations are evidence, not set inputs.
reason_text.not_reference_population: Another population than the one this drug's set is built from (healthy adults are preferred); not used to build or test.
reason_text.held_out_study: Held-out study: its observations only test a set, they never build one.
reason_text.observation_in_building_study: An observation in a study that also reports building parameters; not tested.
reason_text.same_study_in_another_source: May be the same study as one in another source (shared trial number, study code or identical results); kept on the building side, not tested.
reason_text.not_needed_preferred_basis: Not needed: a preferred basis or a pooled value was used.
reason_text.auc_to_last_sampling_time_not_comparable: AUC to the last sampling time: that time is not in the evidence.
reason_text.not_an_observation: Not an observation of Cmax or AUC.
reason_text.needs_oral_dose: A test needs an oral dose.
reason_text.auc_tau_needs_multiple_dose_interval: AUC over a dosing interval needs a multiple-dose arm with its interval.
reason_text.steady_state_cmax_not_modelled: Steady-state Cmax is not modelled in this milestone.
reason_text.auc_inf_needs_single_dose: AUC to infinity needs a single-dose arm.
reason_text.set_has_no_absorption_rate: The set has no absorption rate, so it cannot predict Cmax.
reason_text.set_cannot_predict_metric: The set cannot predict this metric.
reason_text.no_parameter_set: There is no parameter set to test.
reason_text.no_independent_observation: No independent observation: no held-out study reports Cmax or AUC.
reason_text.point_outside_2_fold: At least one held-out observation is outside 2-fold of the prediction.
reason_text.all_points_within_2_fold: AUC and Cmax were tested and every held-out observation is within 2-fold.
reason_text.no_confirmed_clearance: No confirmed clearance (intravenous CL or oral CL/F).
reason_text.no_confirmed_volume: No confirmed volume (Vss or Vd, or V/F).
reason_text.iv_evidence_incomplete: Intravenous evidence is incomplete: clearance and volume are both needed.
reason_text.iv_without_bioavailability: Intravenous clearance and volume exist but no confirmed oral bioavailability.
reason_text.no_volume_and_no_half_life: No volume (V/F) and no half-life to derive it.
reason_text.missing_absorption_no_peak_time: Absorption rate missing: no confirmed time of peak concentration.
reason_text.missing_absorption_no_solution: Absorption rate missing: the peak time is at or beyond what the elimination rate allows.
reason_text.bioavailability_capped: A bioavailability above 1 was capped at 1.
reason_text.half_life_inconsistent: The half-life implied by CL and V differs from the stated half-life by more than 1.5-fold; the curve tail is not supported.
reason_text.studies_disagree: The studies disagree by more than 2-fold.
reason_text.reference_population_patients: No healthy-adult value: the set is built from values in patients (and values whose population is not stated) and is tested only on such observations.
reason_text.no_central_volume_evidence: No central-volume evidence (no distribution phase): one compartment.
reason_text.two_volumes_differ: Central and steady-state volumes differ by at least 25 %: two compartments.
reason_text.two_volumes_agree: Central and steady-state volumes agree within 25 %: one compartment.
reason_text.ka_from_tmax: ka solves tmax = ln(ka/k) / (ka - k) with k = CL / V
reason_text.cl_from_dose_and_auc: Derived: CL/F = dose / AUC to infinity of one study arm (CL for an intravenous dose).
reason_text.f_fixed_apparent: Fixed at 1: apparent parameters already contain bioavailability.
reason_text.clearance_or_bioavailability: Clearance (CL or CL/F) or bioavailability: AUC is outside 2-fold.
reason_text.absorption_rate_or_volume: Absorption rate (derived from the time of peak concentration) or volume: Cmax is outside 2-fold.
reason_text.n_very_small: n is very small: shares and fold errors describe these drugs, not drugs in general.
reason_text.two_automated_passes: Every held-out observation was read automatically and confirmed by two automated passes.
reason_text.confirmed_precision_below_target: On a blinded sample of confirmed values, two automated review passes found fewer correct values than the 90 % target of this milestone (the measured share, n and interval are in the report). Read every value as unverified.
reason_text.expert_review_pending: Expert review has not yet been done.
reason_text.sp_statements_note: Exposure ratios as the US label states them, quoted. Two independent automated readers agree on each; no person has checked them. They are not carried into this drug's model and are not dose advice.
reason_text.sp_atlas_note: Rows of the older-adult exposure atlas: one automated extraction that the two-reader rule did not confirm and that no person has checked. Evidence only, not a verdict.
reason_text.sp_none: No special-population statement was confirmed for this drug.
reason_text.two_readers_agree: Two independent automated readers agree; not checked by a person.
reason_text.automated_extraction_unconfirmed: One automated extraction, not confirmed by the two-reader rule, not checked by a person.
reason_text.interval_n_too_small: No interval is shown: fewer than 20 independent held-out studies.
reason_text.interval_system_level_only: Intervals are given at system level only, not per drug.
reason_text.interval_shown: Intervals are shown: at least 20 independent held-out studies.
reason_text.gate_not_interpretable: Fewer than 10 drugs have both AUC and Cmax tested on held-out studies.
reason_text.intervals_not_shown: No prediction intervals are shown: not enough held-out studies.
reason_text.formulation_often_unspecified: More than a quarter of confirmed values have no stated formulation.
reason_text.fewer_than_150_sets: Fewer than 150 drugs have a parameter set.

reason_text.bioavailability_capped: A bioavailability above 1 was capped at 1.
reason_text.half_life_inconsistent: The half-life implied by CL and V differs from the stated half-life by more than 1.5-fold; the curve tail is not supported.
reason_text.studies_disagree: The studies disagree by more than 2-fold.
reason_text.reference_population_patients: No healthy-adult value: the set is built from values in patients (and values whose population is not stated) and is tested only on such observations.
reason_text.no_central_volume_evidence: No central-volume evidence (no distribution phase): one compartment.
reason_text.two_volumes_differ: Central and steady-state volumes differ by at least 25 %: two compartments.
reason_text.two_volumes_agree: Central and steady-state volumes agree within 25 %: one compartment.
reason_text.ka_from_tmax: ka solves tmax = ln(ka/k) / (ka - k) with k = CL / V
reason_text.cl_from_dose_and_auc: Derived: CL/F = dose / AUC to infinity of one study arm (CL for an intravenous dose).
reason_text.f_fixed_apparent: Fixed at 1: apparent parameters already contain bioavailability.
reason_text.clearance_or_bioavailability: Clearance (CL or CL/F) or bioavailability: AUC is outside 2-fold.
reason_text.absorption_rate_or_volume: Absorption rate (derived from the time of peak concentration) or volume: Cmax is outside 2-fold.
reason_text.n_very_small: n is very small: shares and fold errors describe these drugs, not drugs in general.
reason_text.two_automated_passes: Every held-out observation was read automatically and confirmed by two automated passes.
reason_text.confirmed_precision_below_target: On a blinded sample of confirmed values, two automated review passes found fewer correct values than the 90 % target of this milestone (the measured share, n and interval are in the report). Read every value as unverified.
reason_text.expert_review_pending: Expert review has not yet been done.
reason_text.sp_statements_note: Exposure ratios as the US label states them, quoted. Two independent automated readers agree on each; no person has checked them. They are not carried into this drug's model and are not dose advice.
reason_text.sp_atlas_note: Rows of the older-adult exposure atlas: one automated extraction that the two-reader rule did not confirm and that no person has checked. Evidence only, not a verdict.
reason_text.sp_none: No special-population statement was confirmed for this drug.
reason_text.two_readers_agree: Two independent automated readers agree; not checked by a person.
reason_text.automated_extraction_unconfirmed: One automated extraction, not confirmed by the two-reader rule, not checked by a person.
reason_text.interval_n_too_small: No interval is shown: fewer than 20 independent held-out studies.
reason_text.interval_system_level_only: Intervals are given at system level only, not per drug.
reason_text.interval_shown: Intervals are shown: at least 20 independent held-out studies.
reason_text.gate_not_interpretable: Fewer than 10 drugs have both AUC and Cmax tested on held-out studies.
reason_text.intervals_not_shown: No prediction intervals are shown: not enough held-out studies.
reason_text.formulation_often_unspecified: More than a quarter of confirmed values have no stated formulation.
reason_text.fewer_than_150_sets: Fewer than 150 drugs have a parameter set.
